question: An employee who joins DMRC on Deputation basis and is absorbed later on, how the information related to his PVR is maintained in DMRC?

question: When an employee is in service, he/she went through medical check-up by nominated hospital. What is the duration of validity of the medical fitness report?

question: When can an employee become eligible to get NOC for Higher Education for pursuing correspondence/ part time/ distance learning mode?

question: If the remark (at the end of probation period) on the last assessment of an employee is “Not suitable”, then what will happen?
answer: The probationer may be treated as on further extended probation. A maximum period of one year of extended probation can be allowed at the discretion of Management only, if, it is felt that the probationer can improve and earn suitability during the extended probation period.

question: If an employee is inducted on Direct Recruitment basis. What is their probation period?
answer: (i) Minimum period of 01-year, in case of induction at the level of DGM & above. (ii) Minimum period of 02 years for non-Executive cadre up to the level of Manager.

question: At the end of extended probation period, if the probationer review does not merit ‘Suitable’ assessment. Then what happens?
answer: If at the end of probation period including extended period, the probationer review does not merit ‘Suitable’ assessment, his / her services shall be terminated forthwith, in accordance with the terms of offer of appointment.

question: If an employee is promoted from Non-Executive to Executive, then what is the probation period?
answer: In such case, the probation period shall be 24 months.

question: Is the service rendered during contractual tenure considered as residency period for promotion purpose?
answer: Subsequent upon regularization, the contract service of such employees shall be counted @ maximum up to 70% for further promotion in DMRC. The maximum period of past contract service shall not exceed the quantum of 1.4 years (approx. 70% of 02 years), for promotion purposes and for other purposes including availing of various advances.

question: If the discipline of an employee is changed at his/her own request, then how is the seniority in the new discipline fixed?

question: If the discipline of an employee is changed on administrative ground, then how is the new seniority fixed?
answer: The employee will get his / her due seniority in the new discipline, reckoned from the date of entry to the grade.

question: If an employee fails to submit his/her Self Appraisal of APAR then what happens?

question: What is the minimum period for which an employee should have rendered service for generation of his / her APAR?

question: What are the working hours of an employee of O&M wing working at Depot / Station / Crew Control / OCC?

question: Can an employee combine joining time with CL?

question: Can an employee avail joining time in parts?

question: After how many years of service in DMRC, an employee becomes eligible for permission to pursue an online generic course?

question: What is the maximum limit of fee reimbursement for online courses per block of 3 years?

question: Will an employee get incentive after successful completion of online course?

question: Upon immediate joining in DMRC, will the employee be eligible to seek NOC for outside employment?
answer:
For new recruits (who join DMRC, on direct recruitment basis), it will be a condition on their appointment that no application of theirs would be forwarded for outside employment until they complete their probation period and one-year regular service in the Corporation thereafter. 
On completion of the said period, only four applications per calendar year will be forwarded for outside employment in Govt. department / office. Out of four applications, only two can be for deputation basis.

question: What is the condition for forwarding application for outside employment for absorbed employees?
answer: For absorbed employees (employees who join DMRC, initially on deputation and are absorbed later), no application will be forwarded for outside employment until they complete two years of service after absorption. Thereafter four applications per calendar year will be forwarded for outside employment in Govt. department / office.

question: For a deputations, how many applications of outside employment will be forwarded to their parent unit in one calendar year?
answer: In case of deputationists, only one application per calendar year will be forwarded to their parent unit.

question: If an employee has not taken prior permission for forwarding of application, will he/she get an NOC at the time of interview?

Post facto consideration of such request is not allowed.

question: In case of contract employees, will their application for outside employment be forwarded by Corporation?
answer: In case of contractual employees, forwarding of application for outside employment is not required. In such cases, however intimation of outside employment application is mandatory.

question: How many years of service is required to pursue regular / full time education program?

question: What is the general procedure for allotment?
answer: For staff quarters Upto Type-IV: Upon receiving notice that quarter is vacant, and ready for allotment, the HR wing notifies the respective Committee of the pool. The Committee then issues a notice to inform the shortlisted employees, based on their position in the priority list and their willingness for the quarter location, so as to avoid withdrawal later. After this exercise, the Committee forwards their name to the  HR wing for issuing allotment notice. (Para 8 of Rules) For staff quarters Type-V & above: For Common Pool II, the recommendation for allotment of quarter, as per the priority list and willingness of employee, shall be made by Admin. Deptt. after approval of DF.

question: Whether allotment shall be made to both wife and husband if they both work in the government sector (one of them being in DMRC)?
answer: If the husband and wife are both working in government sector (one of them being in DMRC), the spouse working in DMRC can register for DMRC staff quarter. However, the other spouse having occupation of government accommodation will have to surrender the same, before they occupy the DMRC quarter. A declaration to this effect will be taken at the time of registration by the DMRC employee.

question: What are common proceedings?
answer: Where two or more employees are concerned in a case, the authority competent to impose a major penalty on all such employees may make an order directing that disciplinary proceedings against all of them may be taken in a common proceedings and the specified authority may function as the disciplinary authority for the purpose of such common proceedings.

Provided that no such sanction shall be required if material/ contribution is of a purely literary artistic or scientific character. c.    No employee of the Corporation shall, except with the previous sanction of the Competent Authority is permitted to take part in any show or act in the film

question: In case of contract employees, will their application for outside employment be forwarded by Corporation?
answer: In case of contractual employees, forwarding of application for outside employment is not required. In such cases, however intimation of outside employment application is mandatory.

question: If an employee is on contract, then after how many years of service, he/she will be eligible for permission for higher studies?
answer:
For employees on contract, permission for pursuing higher studies (part time/correspondence/distance learning mode only) shall be given, only on completion of their 3 years’ service in DMRC. 
However, they will not be eligible for any incentive for acquiring higher qualification.

question: Whether contractual services subsequent upon regularisation can be considered for eligibility of HBA?
answer: Yes, 70% period of contractual service shall be considered.

question: Is the service rendered during contractual tenure considered as residency period for promotion purpose?
answer: Subsequent upon regularization, the contract service of such employees shall be counted @ maximum up to 70% for further promotion in DMRC. The maximum period of past contract service shall not exceed the quantum of 1.4 years (approx. 70% of 02 years), for promotion purposes and for other purposes including availing of various advances.

question: What is the maximum limit of fee reimbursement for online courses per block of 3 years?
answer: Fee reimbursement shall be restricted to Rs. 12,000/- per block of 3 years (from completion of one course).

question: What is the crucial date of ascertaining eligibility?
answer: The crucial date of ascertaining eligibility would be the 1st of the month in which open market recruitment advertisement is published / notified

question: How many days of joining time will an employee get when he/she has to join a new post within Delhi/NCR?
answer: 1 day joining time is admissible in such cases.

question: An employee who joins DMRC on Deputation basis and is absorbed later on, how the information related to his PVR is maintained in DMRC?
answer: The requirement of PVR is relaxed in case of such employees, who join DMRC on Deputation basis / absorbed in DMRC after completion of deputation, as they are joining DMRC after proper relieving from another Govt. organization / entity.

question: An employee who joins DMRC on Deputation basis and is absorbed later on, how the information related to his PVR is maintained in DMRC?
answer: The requirement of PVR is relaxed in case of such employees, who join DMRC on Deputation basis / absorbed in DMRC after completion of deputation, as they are joining DMRC after proper relieving from another Govt. organization / entity.

question: Would the Deputationists be granted seniority upon absorption, in DMRC, as per his parent department’s seniority?
answer: The seniority of a deputationists upon absorption in DMRC shall count from the date following the date of acceptance of his/her resignation by the parent organization.In case, an employee is absorbed in a grade corresponding to his/her substantive grade in parent cadre, the service rendered in the parent cadre as well as on deputation in DMRC, shall be counted for the next promotion.

question: If an employee is inducted on Direct Recruitment basis. What is their probation period?
answer: (i) Minimum period of 01-year, in case of induction at the level of DGM & above. (ii) Minimum period of 02 years for non-Executive cadre up to the level of Manager.

question: The Order of the Disciplinary Authority can be challenged, before whom?
answer: The Appellate Authority, as defined under Rule 50 of the DMRC Conduct Discipline and Appeal Rules.

question: Where are the Disciplinary Authority, Appellate Authority and Reviewing Authority notified?
answer: The Disciplinary Authority, Appellate Authority and Reviewing Authority, for each grade, has been defined in the Rule 41 along-with the Schedule – A of the DMRC Conduct Discipline and Appeal Rules.

question: If the discipline of an employee is changed at his/her own request, then how is the seniority in the new discipline fixed?
answer: The seniority in the new discipline is fixed at the bottom of the list.

question: If the discipline of an employee is changed on administrative ground, then how is the new seniority fixed?
answer: The employee will get his / her due seniority in the new discipline, reckoned from the date of entry to the grade.

question: If the distance between an employee’s old HQ and new HQ is 1000 Km or less. How many days of joining time will he/she get?
answer: 10 days (in case of travel by air: 7 days) are admissible in such cases.

question: If the distance between an employee’s old HQ and new HQ is more than 2000 Km. How many days of joining time will he/she get?
answer: 15 days (in case of travel by air: 12 days) are admissible in such cases.

question: If the distance between an employee’s old HQ and new HQ is more than1000 Km and less than 2000 Km. How many days of joining time will he/she get?
answer: 12 days (in case of travel by air: 9 days) are admissible in such cases.

question: Who are exempted from the DMRC Conduct, Discipline and Appeal Rules?
answer: a.    Those in casual employment or paid from contingencies, and, b.   Those who are inducted on Contract (Re-Employment, Retainership basis, Consultant, Advisor, Post Retirement Contractual Engagement, Contract)

question: If an employee requests for early relieving (i.e., before 90 days), then how he/she can get approval?
answer: If employee requests for early relieving (i.e., before 90 days), they can be allowed to do so with the approval of the Competent Authority i.e., concerned Director, and by making payment equivalent to last drawn (Basic Pay + DA) for the balance shortfall period.

question: When can an employee become eligible to get NOC for Higher Education for pursuing correspondence/ part time/ distance learning mode?
answer: Employee becomes eligible for such NOC, after completion of Probation and further 01-year regular service, after that.

question: If an employee is pursuing any educational course prior to the appointment in DMRC, can he/she continue?
answer: The employees, who were already pursuing any educational course prior to the time of appointment in DMRC, will require to obtain permission to continue pursuing the same. However, permission shall not be granted to such candidates who are pursuing regular full-time educational courses and the remaining duration of such courses are required to be completed through full time mode only.

question: What is the education qualification for the post of MTS?
answer: The education qualification for the MTS shall be Matriculation / Xth pass.

question: Can permission be given to an employee to pursue more than one educational course at any given time?
answer: No. Employee is not given permission to pursue two educational courses simultaneously.

question: In case of two DMRC employees being married to each other, can they both make claim for child birth gift?
answer: No, in such case, only one employee (on whom the child is dependent in DMRC records) may make the claim.

question: Whether house can be purchased jointly with the spouse, while availing HBA?
answer: Yes, in this case a NOC to mortgage the property with DMRC will be submitted by the spouse on non-judicial stamp paper.

question: Whether employee is eligible for 2nd HBA after complete repayment of 1st HBA.
answer: No. Not more than one advance shall be admissible to an employee during the entire service.

question: Who shall be eligible for consideration for Compassionate Appointment in DMRC?
answer: The dependent of a deceased employee shall be eligible for consideration for appointment on compassionate grounds, on need-cum-eligibility/suitability for the post.

question: An employee selected against an Advt. dated 2016 joined DMRC in May 2017 due to some reasons and such extension was granted to him by Competent Authority. Another employee selected for the same post against an Advt. dated Jan 2017 joined DMRC in March 2017. Which of the two employees will be senior?
answer: Candidates selected for appointment at an earlier selection shall be senior to those selected later, irrespective of date of joining within the stipulated period.

question: Can an employee avail joining time in parts?
answer: Joining time should be availed in a single stretch, within six months from the relieving date, on transfer. It cannot be, under any circumstances, be availed in parts.

question: Whether employee is eligible for HBA during probation/Contractual period?
answer: No, only regular, confirmed and absorbed employee of the Corporation with minimum 2 ½ years continuous service as on the date of application for advance will be eligible.

question: If an employee fails to submit his/her Self Appraisal of APAR then what happens?
answer: In case, an employee fails to initiate their APAR within the stipulated time frame, the Reporting Authority can initiate the employee’s APAR without the Self-Appraisal and follow the regular course of action on APAR.

question: Do all employees are required to fill the APR?
answer:
No.
APR is required to be filled by Executives of DMRC [Including Direct recruits / Deputationists / Contractual/Post Retirement Contractual Engagement]

question: For transfer of an employee from O&M to Project or Vice versa, who is the Competent Approving authority?
answer: Approval of both the concerned Directors is required, in such cases.

question: Family in relation to an employee includes as per the DMRC Conduct, Discipline and
answer: a.    Employee’s Spouse,

question: If an employee is inducted on Direct Recruitment basis. What is their probation period?
answer: (i) Minimum period of 01-year, in case of induction at the level of DGM & above. (ii) Minimum period of 02 years for non-Executive cadre up to the level of Manager.

question: If an employee is transferred on his/her own request, will he/she be eligible for CTG and other transfer facilities?
answer: No, such facilities are admissible for transfers on administrative grounds only.

question: In case of two DMRC employees marrying each other, are they both eligible to claim marriage gift?
answer: Yes, in such case, both the DMRC employees may claim marriage gift.

question: If an employee has tendered the resignation, then during notice period of 90 days what kind of leaves he/she can avail?
answer: Subsequent upon tendering resignation, an employee is allowed to avail only CL/RH during the notice period of 90 days.

question: If an employee gets temporarily transferred (for a period not exceeding 180 days). Will he/she get joining time?
answer:
No. 
Only the actual transit time is allowed, as in the case of journey on tour.

question: Two employees, competing for the same post, secure the same marks in the DPC. How will their seniority be determined?
answer: In case two or more candidates securing same number in the aggregate, their relative merit position for the purpose of empanelment may be determined on the basis of their relative seniority in the feeder grade. The same logic will be applied to fill up the last vacancy.

question: Are all the employees of DMRC, members of SWF?
answer: Only regular and contract employee of the Corporation including absorbee’s, are members and it doesn’t include deputationist, re-employment, consultants and a person employed on daily wages or apprentices paid under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961.

question: What would be paid to a person if he/she is engaged on PRCE basis?
answer: Only a consolidated amount shall be paid according to the substantive pay scale from which they had retired from the Govt/PSUs.

question: What is meant by Essential Quota and who is entitled for the same?
answer: 10% of staff quarters for phase III and IV will be reserved for essential staff (non-executives only), to ensure expeditious attention towards teething problems related to new technology like UTO, PDS, CBTC which may hamper train services. (Para 11 of Rules).

question: If an Executive performs duty on his/her weekly rest. Will he/she be eligible for compensatory rest?
answer: No. Executives are not eligible for compensatory rest in this condition.

question: At the end of extended probation period, if the probationer review does not merit ‘Suitable’ assessment. Then what happens?
answer: If at the end of probation period including extended period, the probationer review does not merit ‘Suitable’ assessment, his / her services shall be terminated forthwith, in accordance with the terms of offer of appointment.

question: How many CL are available for field staff?
answer: 12 nos. of CL are available for the field staff.

question: How many GH/NH are available for field staff?
answer: 15 nos. GH/NH are available for the field staff.

question: Whether employee can get finance from other financial institutions along with HBA?
answer: Yes, permission for 2nd mortgage can be given, however first mortgage shall be done by DMRC and original documents shall also be retained by DMRC.

question: What is the rule for employment of near relatives of the employees in any corporation or firm enjoying patronage of the corporation?
answer: a.    No employee shall use his/her position or influence directly or indirectly to secure employment for any person related whether by blood or marriage to the employee or to the employee’s wife or husband; whether such a person is dependent on the employee or not. b.   No employee shall, except with the previous sanction of the Competent Authority permit his/her son, daughter or any member of the family to accept employment with any Company or firm with which he has official dealings, or with any Company or firm, having official dealings with the Corporation c.    No employee shall in the discharge of his/her official duties deal with any matter or give or sanction any contract to any Company or firm or any other person if any member of his/her family is employed in that Company or firm.

question: The grant of Funeral assistance in case of death of a family member, includes which all family members?
answer: The grant is applicable in case of death of family members viz. spouse, child and parents, irrespective of their dependency status and the condition that they were staying with the employee.

question: What is the General Conduct which is to be observed by every employee?
answer: Every employee of the Corporation shall at all times: - a.    maintain absolute integrity b.   maintain devotion to duty c.    do nothing which is unbecoming of a public servant.

question: How many GH/NH are available for field staff?
answer: 15 nos. GH/NH are available for the field staff.

question: What is the amount for Child Birth Gift? For how many children, this may be claimed?
answer: Rs.2,500/- is given as Child birth gift, which is limited to first two children only. However, in case the second delivery results in birth of twin children, then the grant shall be admissible for both the twins.

question: The grant of marriage gift for son / daughter of employee is admissible to only non-executive employees or is it admissible for the Executive employees also
answer: It is applicable to both Executive and Non-Executive employees.

question: Upon Resignation from DMRC to join another Govt. Organization, through proper channel, with less than 5 years’ service in DMRC, can the Gratuity be transferred to that other Govt. Organization?
answer:
Transfer of Gratuity, even if, service is less than 5 years in DMRC, if, employee joins other Government organization through proper channel their service is treated as continuous service and all benefits are transferable.
An undertaking from the prospective employer, i.e., other Government organization, should also be taken that if the employee resigns from there, before completing 5 years (DMRC service put together) the gratuity paid will be refunded to DMRC.

question: Is it possible   to repay HBA before the scheduled period?
answer: Yes, any time employee can make part repayment of outstanding sum or foreclose it completely.

question: Is it possible   to sell the house before re-payment of HBA?
answer: No, release of original property papers and transfer of the property shall be done only after clearing the outstanding HBA with DMRC.

question: What is the maximum period for repayment of HBA?
answer: Maximum period for repayment of HBA is 20 years (15 years principal and 5 years interest)

question: Whether HBA may be granted to purchase a property on Power of Attorney?
answer: No, HBA will be given on Registered/Government approved property.

question: How much HBA amount can be sanctioned to an employee?
answer: As per DMRC House Building Advance Rules, "HBA limit including  cost  of  land  of  the  house  is  60  times  of  basic  pay  or ₹ 40.00 lakh or cost of property whichever is less."

question: If an employee completes a Higher Education course, after obtaining NOC from DMRC and secures less than 60% marks, will he / she still be eligible for grant of incentive on acquiring such qualification.
answer:
No. 
Only the qualification will be added in the service records as incentive is applicable in only those cases, where employee secures more than 60% marks.

question: If Honorarium is paid for working on weekly rest day to an O&M employee, then will he/she be eligible to get compensatory rest/conveyance charge also?
answer: Where honorarium is paid for working on weekly rest day, like exam duty etc., no Compensatory Rest/ conveyance charges will be admissible for O&M employees.

question: Can an employee purchase a house beyond cost ceiling limit of ₹1.00 cr, while availing HBA.
answer: Yes, maximum up to 25% over the ceiling limit with reasonable income sources may be approved.

question: Upon immediate joining in DMRC, will the employee be eligible to seek NOC for outside employment?
answer:
For new recruits (who join DMRC, on direct recruitment basis), it will be a condition on their appointment that no application of theirs would be forwarded for outside employment until they complete their probation period and one-year regular service in the Corporation thereafter. 
On completion of the said period, only four applications per calendar year will be forwarded for outside employment in Govt. department / office. Out of four applications, only two can be for deputation basis.

question: Will an employee get incentive after successful completion of online course?
answer: No incentive is admissible for completing the online course. Only the course fee, within the prescribed limit, is reimbursable, subject to completion of course.

question: What are the conditions for inclusion of a qualification in service records / monetary incentive for qualification acquired after obtaining due permission?
answer: Qualification/s acquired after obtaining due permission from Management shall be considered for inclusion in the service records / departmental promotions / monetary incentive etc. if attained with minimum 60% marks or an equitable grade thereof.

question: The Indemnity Bond required to be filled by employee seeking incentive on completion of higher education course requires the employee to be in DMRC’s service for how many years?
answer: It requires the employee to be in DMRC’s service for atleast 02 years.

question: An employee who joins DMRC on Deputation basis and is absorbed later on, how the information related to his PVR is maintained in DMRC?
answer: The requirement of PVR is relaxed in case of such employees, who join DMRC on Deputation basis / absorbed in DMRC after completion of deputation, as they are joining DMRC after proper relieving from another Govt. organization / entity.

question: Can an employee avail joining time in parts?
answer: Joining time should be availed in a single stretch, within six months from the relieving date, on transfer. It cannot be, under any circumstances, be availed in parts.

question: Can an employee combine joining time with CL?
answer: Joining time can be combined with any kind of leave except casual leave.

question: If an employee joins other Government department through proper channel. What kind of leaves can be transferred?
answer: Transfer of the leave both Earned Leave (Encashable& Non-encashable) and Medical Leave (LHAP).

question: Whether sanctioned HBA can lapse?
answer: Yes, if not utilized within a period of 4 months from the date of issue of the office order

question: If the remark (at the end of probation period) on the last assessment of an employee is “Not suitable”, then what will happen?
answer: The probationer may be treated as on further extended probation. A maximum period of one year of extended probation can be allowed at the discretion of Management only, if, it is felt that the probationer can improve and earn suitability during the extended probation period.

question: What leaves are admissible to those engaged on PRCE basis?
answer: For those working against Regular Posts: - 1.   Special Leave: 01, per completed month. 2.   Casual Leave: 08/12 in a calendar year, as admissible to regular employees. 3.   Restricted Holidays: 02, at par with regular employees.

question: What is License Fee?
answer: License fee means the sum of money payable monthly in addition to HRA with respect to residence allotted under these rules. (Para 8.6 of the Rules)

question: What is age limit for candidates, to be considered for Post-Retirement Contractual Engagement basis?
answer: The age of the candidates should be between the ages 55 years to 62 years, as on the crucial date. However, Corporation reserves the right to relax both the lower and the upper age limits, in exceptional circumstances, warranted on account of public exigency(ies).

question: What are the criteria for change of location, after allotment?
answer: Change of location is not allowed, except under the following circumstances: 1.      Change of location is in the interest of administration, with the approval of with the approval of DF (for Type V and above) / DOS (for quarters upto Type IV). 2.      Medical grounds (as per recommendation of Committee), and based on availability. 3.      Mutual exchange

question: What are Major Penalties which can be imposed on an employee?
answer: a.   [save as provided for in clause 40.1(iv)] Reduction to a lower stage in the time-scale of pay for a specified period, with further directions as to whether or not the employee will earn increments of pay during the period of such reduction and whether on the expiry of such period, the reduction will or will not have the effect of postponing the future increments of his/her pay; b.   Reduction to a lower time-scale of pay, grade, post or service, with or without further directions regarding conditions of restoration to the grade or post or service from which the DMRC employee was reduced and his seniority and pay on such restoration to that grade, post or service; c.   Compulsory Retirement; d.   Removal from service which shall not be a disqualification for future employment under the Government or PSUs; e.    Dismissal from service which shall ordinarily be a disqualification for future employment under the Government or PSUs.

question: In what manner can the Appellate Authority decide the Appeal?
answer: The Appellate Authority may pass order confirming, enhancing, reducing or setting aside the penalty or remitting the case to the authority which imposed the penalty or to any other authority with such direction as it may deem fit in the circumstances of the case.

question: What is the maximum limit of fee reimbursement for online courses per block of 3 years?
answer: Fee reimbursement shall be restricted to Rs. 12,000/- per block of 3 years (from completion of one course).

question: When an employee is in service, he/she went through medical check-up by nominated hospital. What is the duration of validity of the medical fitness report?
answer: The validity of medical fitness report is till 06 months from such medical examination

question: What is the minimum and maximum age for a candidate for recruitment in DMRC?
answer: The minimum age for the applicant shall be 18 years of age. The maximum age shall be 32 years for ‘Executive’ posts and 33 years for ‘non-executive’ posts, with the usual relaxation for reserved categories as per the guidelines of the Govt. of India, as issued from time to time

question: What is the minimum and maximum age for a departmental candidate, to be considered for open market recruitment in DMRC?
answer: The Existing DMRC employees who have completed at least 3 years continuous service in DMRC, as on the crucial date, shall be given an upper-age relaxation/limit to the extent, that for Executive posts, the maximum age relaxation shall be UR – by 5 years, OBC – 8 years and SC/ST –10 years and for Non-Executive posts, the upper-age limit for the employee shall be for UR – 40 years, OBC – 43 years and SC/ST – 45 years

question: What is the minimum floor area of property for availing HBA.?
answer: Minimum floor area should not be less than 33 sq. mt.

question: What is the minimum period for which an employee should have rendered service for generation of his / her APAR?
answer: The employee should have completed minimum 90 days of service in the Corporation on assessment year ending, i.e., on 31st March of the year.

question: What are the minimum qualifying marks in the Computer Based Test and Personal Interview?
answer: The minimum qualifying marks in the Computer Based Test and Personal Interview for UR/EWS candidates will be 40%. For SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates the qualifying marks will be 30%.

question: What are Minor Penalties which can be imposed on an employee?
answer: a.  Censure b.   Withholding of his/her promotion c.    Recovery from his/her pay of the whole or part of any pecuniary loss caused by him/her to the Corporation by negligence or breach of orders d.   Reduction to a lower stage in the time-scale of pay by one stage for a period not exceeding three years, without cumulative effect and not adversely affecting his/her terminal benefits. e.    Withholding of increments of pay

question: How mutual exchange of accommodation can be sought?
answer: For the personal convenience of two allottees, mutual exchange of accommodation is permitted on a request received from both allottees through their respective departments.

question: For celebration of which National Festival, there is provision to release grant to the Staff quarters under SWF Rules?
answer: Only for celebration of Independence Day, a fixed amount, which is based on the number of occupied flats, is granted to the RRAs of the staff quarters for celebration.

question: If an employee has not availed joining time, as admissible. What will happen to the un-availed portion of joining time?
answer: When the employee joins the new post without availing of full joining time, as admissible, the un-availed portion of joining time shall be credited to his / her earned leave account (non-encash able) subject to the restrictions on accumulation of earned leave.

question: What is the notice period required for tendering resignation and seeking relieving from employment of DMRC?
answer: The notice period required for tendering resignation and seeking relieving from employment of DMRC is 90 days

question: What are the working hours of an employee of O&M wing working at Depot / Station / Crew Control / OCC?
answer: All work centers of O&M Wing like Depots, Stations, Crew Controls, OCC etc. will function on 6 days a week (8 hours a day) and shifts / duty for round the clock functioning.

question: After how many years of service in DMRC, an employee becomes eligible for permission to pursue an online generic course?
answer: The online courses, from the approved list, can be undertaken by any regular employee / contract employees who has put in 02 years’ services, irrespective of their being in any job profile. Prior permission would be required to pursue online courses though.

question: Whether employee can be penalized for non submission of original title deed on time.?
answer: Yes, if, the employee fail to submit the original documents of property with-in one month of withdrawal of final instalment of HBA or completion certificate, whichever is earlier, a flat 2% interest over and above the normal HBA interest shall be charged on total withdrawn advance amount as a penalty.

question: For a deputations, how many applications of outside employment will be forwarded to their parent unit in one calendar year?
answer: In case of deputationists, only one application per calendar year will be forwarded to their parent unit.

question: How much is the life of the panel?
answer: The life of the recruitment panel shall be two years from the date of approval by the Competent Authority, which may be extended by one more year with the approval of the Managing Director

question: My father has a plot. Can I avail HBA for construction of house on this plot?
answer: No, title of the land should be in the name of the employee.

question: How many pay-scales are there for Executive posts?
answer: There are 10 pay-scales for Executive posts.

question: How many pay-scales are there for non-executive posts?
answer: There are 11 pay-scales for non-executive posts.

question: What is the penal rent payable upon occupation beyond cancellation of allotment or overstayal beyond admissible quarter retention limit?
answer: When an employee continues to occupy a staff quarter, whose allotment in his/her favour has been cancelled or is deemed to be cancelled, he/she will be liable to pay per month penal rent equal to one month’s basic pay of the allottee w.e.f. the date of cancellation/overstayal of the allotment.

question: What types of penalties may be imposed against an allottee is found to be guilty of subletting?
answer: In case of subletting or sharing of accommodation with unauthorized persons, the HR Department may, after detailed enquiry, cancel the allotment and undertake disciplinary action.

question: What is the period of engagement and SOP for Post-Retirement Contractual Engagement?
answer: (i)   Initial engagement: for one year, which may be extended, upto 62 years of age, or, one year from the date of engagement, whichever is later.

question: What is the periodicity of APAR?
answer: The periodicity of APAR is - 1st April to 31st March, every year.

question: Can an employee seek extension for taking possession of quarter after allotment?
answer: After allotment, extension for taking possession up to 3 months may be given in genuine cases (i.e. problems faced due to ongoing academic session of children, medical condition etc.) with the approval of HoD / HR/O&M department, for staff quarters (Type II, III and IV) at all locations and with the approval of HoD/Admin. for staff quarters (Type V and above) at all locations. Double license fees will be charged for the duration of extended period. (Para 12.3 of the Rules)

question: What are the different types of Post Retirement Contractual Engagement?
answer: (i)       Re-employment: against regular post (ii)     Consultant: against regular post and otherwise (iii)    Advisor: against regular post and otherwise (iv)    Retainership: not against a regular post

question: Under Review of service, the premature removal of an Executive from service of DMRC requires whose approval?
answer: The premature removal of an Executive from service of DMRC, under this clause, shall require the approval of the Board of Directors.

question: If an employee has not taken prior permission for forwarding of application, will he/she get an NOC at the time of interview?
answer: “No Objection Certificate” will not be granted at the time of interview unless application is forwarded officially, through proper channel or permission for applying for outside employment is obtained before applying for the said job. Post facto consideration of such request is not allowed.

question: How is priority fixed for the various types of accommodation?
answer: Now, the process of registration for staff quarters has been moved to ESS. The existing priority list  is updated on ESS as per the date/time of registration being captured on ESS. (Para 7 of Rules)

question: If an employee wants to apply for private job in outside organization, will such application be forwarded by DMRC?
answer:
No.
Such provision is not applicable on request to apply for Private sector jobs.

question: At the end of extended probation period, if the probationer review does not merit ‘Suitable’ assessment. Then what happens?
answer: If at the end of probation period including extended period, the probationer review does not merit ‘Suitable’ assessment, his / her services shall be terminated forthwith, in accordance with the terms of offer of appointment.

question: At the end of extended probation period, if the probationer review does not merit ‘Suitable’ assessment. Then what happens?
answer: If at the end of probation period including extended period, the probationer review does not merit ‘Suitable’ assessment, his / her services shall be terminated forthwith, in accordance with the terms of offer of appointment.

question: Does Probation include period on which employee was on Leave Without Pay
answer: No, the probation period shall exclude Leave without Pay

question: If an employee is inducted on Direct Recruitment basis. What is their probation period?
answer: (i) Minimum period of 01-year, in case of induction at the level of DGM & above. (ii) Minimum period of 02 years for non-Executive cadre up to the level of Manager.

question: If an employee is promoted from Non-Executive to Executive, then what is the probation period?
answer: In such case, the probation period shall be 24 months.

question: If the remark (at the end of probation period) on the last assessment of an employee is “Not suitable”, then what will happen?
answer: The probationer may be treated as on further extended probation. A maximum period of one year of extended probation can be allowed at the discretion of Management only, if, it is felt that the probationer can improve and earn suitability during the extended probation period.

question: If an employee is promoted from Non-Executive to Executive, then what is the probation period?
answer: In such case, the probation period shall be 24 months.

question: If an employee is promoted from Non-Executive to Executive, then what is the probation period?
answer: In such case, the probation period shall be 24 months.

question: Is the service rendered during contractual tenure considered as residency period for promotion purpose?
answer: Subsequent upon regularization, the contract service of such employees shall be counted @ maximum up to 70% for further promotion in DMRC. The maximum period of past contract service shall not exceed the quantum of 1.4 years (approx. 70% of 02 years), for promotion purposes and for other purposes including availing of various advances.

question: What is the definition of Public Servant under DMRC Conduct Discipline and Appeal Rules?
answer: ‘Public Servant’ shall mean and include a person, as mentioned in Section 21 of Indian Penal Code, or, Section 2(28) of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, as applicable, or, as amended from time to time

question: An employee who joins DMRC on Deputation basis and is absorbed later on, how the information related to his PVR is maintained in DMRC?
answer: The requirement of PVR is relaxed in case of such employees, who join DMRC on Deputation basis / absorbed in DMRC after completion of deputation, as they are joining DMRC after proper relieving from another Govt. organization / entity.

question: What is the rate of contribution of employees towards SWF Trust
answer: There are five different rates of contribution, as per the designation of employee:- •   Unskilled, Semi-skilled – Rs.15/- pm •   Below Supervisors – Rs. 20/- pm •   Supervisors – Rs. 35/- pm •   Executives upto AGM – Rs. 60/- pm •   HoDs and above – Rs. 70/- pm

question: What is the rate of interest on HBA?
answer: Applicable rates of interest on HBA are as under: Upto 12 lakh  : 5% From 12 lakh to 15 lakh  : 7.5% From 15 lakh to 50 lakh  : 9%

question: When does the Recruitment Year start / end?
answer: “Recruitment Year” means the year commencing from the 1st of January to the 31st December of the year

question: What is the maximum limit of fee reimbursement for online courses per block of 3 years?
answer: Fee reimbursement shall be restricted to Rs. 12,000/- per block of 3 years (from completion of one course).

question: Is there any provision of release of funds to celebrate Ambedkar Jayanti from SWF?
answer: A lumpsum amount of Rs. 50,000/- may be sanctioned each year to an authorized employee nominated by Liaison Officer.

question: What is the minimum duration for which the Reporting / Reviewing Authority must have supervised the work of an employee, to be able to be the Reporting / Reviewing Authority in APAR?
answer: APAR to be written by the Reporting Officer immediately superior to the employee concerned and reviewed by the next higher authority. In both cases, they should have supervised the work of employee for not less than three months.

question: In case an employee requests for grant of additional joining time (than permissible days), who is the Competent Authority to decide on such request?
answer: MD is the Competent Authority, to consider such requests.

question: Is there any reservation for reserved categories for allotments?
answer: Yes. 10% of quarters will be reserved for SC and ST candidates in Type-II quarters and 5% will be reserved in Type-III and IV. The ratio of SC and ST employees in the reserved quota will be 2:1. (Para 7.8 of Rules)

question: Is the service rendered during contractual tenure considered as residency period for promotion purpose?
answer: Subsequent upon regularization, the contract service of such employees shall be counted @ maximum up to 70% for further promotion in DMRC. The maximum period of past contract service shall not exceed the quantum of 1.4 years (approx. 70% of 02 years), for promotion purposes and for other purposes including availing of various advances.

question: What are the entitlements for various types of residential accommodation?
answer: All staff quarters have been categorized into Type II, Type III, Type IV, Type V and Type VI, each of which can be allotted to a registered employee as per his/her eligibility based on payscale. (Para 3 of Rules).

question: What is the period of retention permissible after an allottee ceases to be eligible?
answer: An allotment is cancelled or is deemed to have been cancelled on the expiry of the concessional period of retention permissible under the Rules or he/she vacates the quarter on his own. The retention period admissible, including the concessional period, and the rates of license fee prescribed thereof for different situations are indicated at Para 12.4 of the Rules.

question: An employee who has been sanctioned HBA for purchase of property wants to change his property after possession. Will he be eligible for continuing HBA on changed property?
answer: No, after availing HBA, employee cannot change his property.

question: Can HBA be sanctioned for purchase of a Plot?
answer: No. For purchase of plot, no HBA will be granted. However if the employee intends to construct a house there on then with this condition upto 40% of the eligible HBA can be sanctioned.

question: What are the modes of selection on Post Retirement Contractual Engagement?

question: Self-Appraisal in the APAR is required to be filled by employees at which level?
answer: All employees are required to submit their self-appraisal, to summarize their achievements during the year under review including specialachievements (if any).

question: The seniority in the grade for an employee who joined DMRC on contract basis is counted from which date?
answer: Seniority will be will counted after applying 70% post service benefits.

question: Are there separate Pools/Quotas within the Parent Pool?
answer: Sub-Pools have been done away with, and each parent department will have one unified priority   list.

question: How many years of service is required to pursue regular / full time education program?
answer:
For pursuing regular/ full-time education program, the request will be considered along with the request for Study Leave. 
Study leave shall be granted to a regular employee who has satisfactorily completed the period of probation and has rendered not less than five years of regular continuous service, including the period of probation.

question: After how many years of service in DMRC, an employee becomes eligible for permission to pursue an online generic course?
answer: The online courses, from the approved list, can be undertaken by any regular employee / contract employees who has put in 02 years’ services, irrespective of their being in any job profile. Prior permission would be required to pursue online courses though.

question: In case of making claim for marriage gift or child birth gift, is it necessary that the spouse or child must be added in their service record?
answer: Yes, for all staff welfare related claims through ESS, all members have to first request for addition of family members in records, and then apply for the claims.

question: Is the service rendered during contractual tenure considered as residency period for promotion purpose?
answer: Subsequent upon regularization, the contract service of such employees shall be counted @ maximum up to 70% for further promotion in DMRC. The maximum period of past contract service shall not exceed the quantum of 1.4 years (approx. 70% of 02 years), for promotion purposes and for other purposes including availing of various advances.

question: How much service a deputationist is required to put-in, to be considered for Absorption?
answer: A deputationist shall be required to put in a minimum of two years’ service in DMRC, for being considered for absorption in DMRC

question: How many years of service is required to pursue regular / full time education program?
answer:
For pursuing regular/ full-time education program, the request will be considered along with the request for Study Leave. 
Study leave shall be granted to a regular employee who has satisfactorily completed the period of probation and has rendered not less than five years of regular continuous service, including the period of probation.

question: What are the various locations of DMRC Staff Quarters?
answer: The various locations of DMRC staff quarters are as under: Ajronda, Bahadurgarh, Gurgaon, Mukundpur, Mundka, Najafgarh, New Ashok Nagar, Sarita Vihar, Shastri Park, Shastri Park Two, Vinod Nagar, Yamuna Bank, Noida, Metro Enclave (Pushp Vihar) & Civil Lines.

question: What is Subletting? Is subletting permissible?
answer: If an allottee shares the accommodation with an ineligible person or he himself does not reside in the premises, but the same is occupied by others (whether eligible for sharing or not), he will be held to have sublet the house. Subletting is not permissible and can attract disciplinary action and/or cancellation of allotment.

question: How much is the Subsistence Allowance paid when paid under suspension, initially?
answer: 50% of Basic Pay

question: When is a Subsistence Allowance given?
answer: At the time of Suspension

question: At the end of extended probation period, if the probationer review does not merit ‘Suitable’ assessment. Then what happens?
answer: If at the end of probation period including extended period, the probationer review does not merit ‘Suitable’ assessment, his / her services shall be terminated forthwith, in accordance with the terms of offer of appointment.

question: How to surrender the staff quarter?
answer: During the period of allotment, the allottee is required to give at least one month notice to the HR/Admin Department before vacating the premises. In case the allottee fails to give notice he/she shall           be responsible for payment of one month license fee. Prior intimation is not mandatory in case of administrative transfer. (Para 8.8. of Rules).

question: In what conditions an employee of DMRC can be placed under Suspension?
answer: a.    Where Disciplinary proceedings against him/her is contemplated or is pending or b.   Where a case against him/her in respect of any criminal offence is under investigation or trial.

question: Is the Tablet PC reimbursement applicable for non-supervisors only?
answer: It is applicable for all non-executive employees.

question: What is the tenure of regularization of TADK?
answer: The tenure for regularization of TADK is 03 years.

question: What is the tenure of regularization of TADK?
answer: The tenure for regularization of TADK is 03 years.

question: The termination process of an employee may be initiated if he / she remains on an unauthorized leave of how many days?
answer: This process may be initiated if an employee remains on unauthorized absence for 60 days or more days

question: What is the time limit for charged official to submit his/her written statement of defence on charge sheet?
answer: The charged official may submit his/her written statement of defence within such time period, as may be specified by the Disciplinary Authority, not exceeding 15 days.

question: In how much time, the Appeal is to be decided?
answer: The Appellate Authority shall consider whether the findings are justified or whether the penalty is excessive or inadequate and pass appropriate orders within three months of the date of appeal.

question: Is there any time-limit to file an appeal against the Order of the Disciplinary Authority?
answer: An appeal shall be preferred within one month from the date of communication of the order appealed against. The appeal shall be addressed to the Appellate Authority specified in the schedule and submitted to the authority whose order is appealed against. The Authority whose order is appealed against shall forward the appeal together with its comments and the records of the case to the Appellate Authority within 15 days.

question: For transfer of an employee’s posting station within the jurisdiction of AM, who is the Competent Approving authority?
answer: Dy. HoD is the Competent Approving Authority

question: Under what circumstances Subsistence Allowances is not payable?
answer: Deemed Suspension, till the time employee is in custody.

question: On what basis the seniority of employees who are transferred on their promotion is determined?
answer: The seniority of employees of DMRC promoted to higher posts shall be maintained as per the panel seniority position, irrespective of the date of assumption of charge of the higher post. This shall be subject to the condition that they assume the charge of the higher post within a period of 06 (six) months, from the date of issuance of the promotion order.

question: If an employee wants to withdraw his/her request of resignation within notice period, can he/she be allowed to do this?
answer: The employee can decide to withdraw the request of resignation, for genuine reasons during the notice period. DMRC reserves the right to accept the withdrawal or otherwise if Management approval for acceptance of resignation has been communicated to the employee.

question: What are the working hours of an employee of O&M wing working at Depot / Station / Crew Control / OCC?
answer: All work centers of O&M Wing like Depots, Stations, Crew Controls, OCC etc. will function on 6 days a week (8 hours a day) and shifts / duty for round the clock functioning.

question: If Honorarium is paid for working on weekly rest day to an O&M employee, then will he/she be eligible to get compensatory rest/conveyance charge also?
answer: Where honorarium is paid for working on weekly rest day, like exam duty etc., no Compensatory Rest/ conveyance charges will be admissible for O&M employees.

question: How many chances are given to a candidate to clear the Written Test, in case of Compassionate Appointment?
answer: A maximum of three chances shall be given to a candidate, while in case of candidates, who are SC/ST/Widow/Wife, a maximum of four chances, shall be given.

question: Can an employee pursue more than one educational course at the same time?
answer: No. Employees cannot pursue two courses simultaneously.

question: Under what conditions will a qualification be included in service records or eligible for incentive?
answer: Qualifications obtained with prior permission (NOC) and at least 60% marks/equivalent grade are eligible for inclusion in service records, promotions, and incentives.

question: How many years of service are required to pursue a regular/full-time education program?
answer: Study leave for full-time programs is granted only after probation + 5 years of continuous service.

question: Can an employee continue an educational course started before joining DMRC?
answer: Yes, with permission. However, no permission is granted for full-time courses requiring completion in regular mode.

question: When are contract employees eligible for permission to pursue higher studies?
answer: After 3 years of service, for part-time/distance/correspondence courses only. They are not eligible for incentives for higher qualifications.

question: What are the requirements for recognition of courses?
answer: Courses must be recognized by AICTE/UGC/DEC or relevant Govt. body, with supporting documents submitted.

question: What is the condition for receiving incentive after higher studies?
answer: Incentive is paid only after submission of an Indemnity Bond (20 Rs Stamp paper) to serve DMRC for at least 2 years post-incentive.

question: After how many years of service in DMRC can an employee pursue an online generic course?
answer: Any regular/contract employee with 2 years of service may pursue approved online courses, with prior permission.

question: What is the maximum fee reimbursement limit for online courses?
answer: Reimbursement is capped at ₹12,000 per block of 3 years, counted from completion of one course.

question: Is any incentive given after successful completion of an online course?
answer: No incentive is admissible. Only course fees, within the prescribed limit, are reimbursed.

question: What is the incentive amount for acquiring higher qualifications?
answer: Ph.D. / Post-Graduation – ₹10,000; Graduation – ₹8,000; PG Diploma (2 years) – ₹6,000; Diploma (3 years) – ₹4,000; Diploma (less than 3 years, approved by Govt. body) proportionate of 3 years course (not less than 6 months period) subject to a minimum Rs.1000/-; Higher Secondary – ₹2,500; High School – ₹1,500.

question: What topics in General courses or Specialized courses are commonly offered through online courses?
answer: The updated list of Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) has been made available on the intranet, dated 26.11.2024.

question: What is the minimum and maximum duration of MOOCs?
answer: Minimum duration is 3 weeks and maximum duration is 12 weeks.

question: Who is eligible for Specialized courses?
answer: Employees of the respective discipline only. RS and Electrical employees can pursue courses of both wings.

question: What's the amount towards festival advance being released?
answer: The present ceiling of festival advance for all non-executive employees is Rs. 7,500.00.

question: What's the eligibility criteria grade wise?
answer: Allowed to staff up to the grade Rs. 40,000.00 -1,25,000.00 only.

question: Completed years of service required?
answer: Applicant should have put in one year regular service.

question: What are the repayment terms?
answer: The advance will be recoverable in maximum 10 installments.

question: What interest rates will be charged?
answer: No interest shall be charged from the employee.

question: Is the advance released on a calendar year or financial year basis?
answer: It's released on a calendar year basis.

question: When employee will be eligible to draw this advance again?
answer: The employee is eligible again after completing the repayment of the previous advance and meeting the required service period, e.g., one year.

question: What is the criteria for regular DMRC employee to apply for NOC for outside job?
answer: Yes, provided the employee meets the minimum service requirement (after probation/absorption) and no disqualifying vigilance or D&AR issues. Contractual employees don’t need forwarding, but must intimate DMRC when they apply elsewhere.

question: How many outside job applications can be forwarded in a year?
answer: Up to four applications can be forwarded per calendar year for Govt./PSU/other government bodies, of which at most two can be for deputation posts.

question: When can a new direct recruit start applying outside through DMRC?
answer: Only after you complete your full probation period and then one additional year of regular service.

question: When can a DMRC employee on getting absorbed after deputation become eligible to apply outside?
answer: The employee can seek forwarding of his applications only after he completes two years of service after absorption in DMRC.

question: Will the applications for UPSC exams be counted in the four-application limit?
answer: Applications for Civil Services, Engineering Services, Indian Forest Service, Indian Economic Service and Indian Statistical Service exams do not count towards your annual limit if you send them directly and only intimate DMRC through proper channel. All other UPSC/Commission posts do count within the four-application limit.

question: Can NOC be applied for a private sector job through DMRC?
answer: No. DMRC does not forward applications to private organizations.

question: What could stop the application for NOC from being forwarded?
answer: Your application will not be forwarded if you are under suspension; have a charge-sheeted disciplinary/vigilance/CBI case; have been sanctioned for prosecution or have a criminal charge-sheet filed; or are currently undergoing a penalty.

question: How do outside applications work for the employee on contract?
answer: While you are contractual, you only need to intimate DMRC when you apply outside; forwarding is not required. After you are regularised, any earlier applications that are still active will start counting within the normal limit and NOC for interviews will depend on your vigilance/D&AR status.

question: Will the NOC be provided if the employee does not meet eligibility criteria?
answer: No, the employee shall meet eligibility criteria such as experience, educational qualification etc. for an NOC to be received. All supplementary documents are mandatory.

question: If the educational qualification is attained after joining DMRC is it necessary to add it in service records for NOC?
answer: Yes, it is mandatory to get the educational qualification added in service records of DMRC to attain NOC for outside employment.

question: Can a permanent employee apply for any contractual post in other govt organization?
answer: Yes, a permanent employee can apply for posts on contractual, direct recruitment, absorption, etc.

question: Is NOC required for transactions done with close relatives?
answer: Yes.

question: What comes under movable property?
answer: Movable property includes jewelry, insurance policies, shares, securities, debentures, motor vehicles, and household appliances like refrigerators, radios, televisions, etc.

question: What is the limit of transaction to be reported in DMRC?

question: What if transactions related to movable property are not reported?

question: If transaction is done by spouse/children does it need reporting?

question: Do expenses on child education abroad need to be reported?
answer: Yes, children’s education abroad also needs to be intimated.
